takes.text: Thirty-one years I've kept Mickey's books, love. I know what every fare cost and who never paid it.

takes.text: Sit down, you're making the place look untidy. Now, what is it you think you want to know?

takes.text: I saw what I saw. Whether I tell anybody else is a different question, isn't it.
